summary.text: Bryce Reeves is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia for District 28, serving since 2012. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Finance and Appropriations, General Laws and Technology, and Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Bryce E. Reeves was born in California on November 28, 1966, according to the Senate's member page.

The page says he earned a B.S. from Texas A&M University and a master's in public administration from George Mason University, and lists his occupation as a provider of insurance and financial products.
The page lists his memberships as including The Gideons International and the Virginia Shooting Sports Association.
